rv.q: Redmond is a highlight as uptight nemesis Shona, particularly during her opening number, in which she sings of the misogyny that powerful women are destined to face. Louise McCarthy as Steve’s former lover Heather Argyll is similarly outstanding, beginning as exaggerated and uppity, and landing somewhere between monstrous and unhinged.
Nonetheless, The High Life:The Musical is a hilarious, camp and fun production which soars from take off until landing, transporting passengers both old and new on a fun ride through sunny skies.
